title: Auth Remediation - Fix AdminAuthCallback Role Detection

summary.problem: AdminAuthCallback.tsx always calls loginAsAdmin() regardless of user role, storing ALL tokens in workos_admin_auth key. This breaks doctor and employer portal access.
summary.solution: Fix role detection in AdminAuthCallback, create DoctorRegistrationForm, add missing route

phases.name: Fix AdminAuthCallback Role Detection

changes: Lines 44-50: Replace loginAsAdmin with role-based logic

tasks: Add hook calls at component level
Replace hardcoded loginAsAdmin with conditional role detection
Run typecheck to verify no errors
verification: Token stored in correct localStorage key based on role

phases.name: Create DoctorRegistrationForm Component

changes: Create new component based on EmployerRegistrationForm pattern

tasks: Create DoctorRegistrationForm.tsx with form fields: name, email, zoomPersonalLink
Implement form submission calling doctorSettings.create mutation

phases.name: Add Doctor Registration Route

changes: After line 46: Add lazy import for DoctorRegistrationForm

tasks: Add Route path='/register/doctor' with Suspense wrapper
